# Owned enum token and scalar fixture

A recursive Enum<Self> method retains Class<E>, an arbitrary int context and
an opaque E result. Source and SDK-provider profiles compile every unit and
preserve original entries, metadata and Exceptions. Four frozen caller routes
run 96 fresh JVM cases twice, checking exact tokens, null/mismatched/non-enum
tokens, signed int extremes, opaque results and exact callback/late failures.
Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving controls guard scope and erasure.
Only owned fixture and standard SDK enum code executes. Use JDK 25 for the
runner; originals use release 8 and recovery uses its reported Java release.
